extracted.name: Easy Greek Yogurt Cucumber Sauce
extracted.description: This easy Greek yogurt cucumber sauce recipe with sour cream, vinegar, lemon, green onion, garlic, feta cheese, and oregano is a copy of a tzatziki sauce.
ingredient_lines: 1 small cucumber - peeled, seeded, and finely chopped
instruction_lines: Combine yogurt, sour cream, cucumber, green onion, feta cheese, garlic, vinegar, oregano, lemon juice, lemon zest, salt, and black pepper in a bowl; cover and chill before serving, 8 hours to overnight.
